[P2] Preserve date proof in YAML responses

Bounded searches add `date_filter` to response metadata, but `format_yaml_markdown` copies metadata through a fixed allowlist that omits this field. Consequently `format=yaml` responses drop the enforcement proof, contrary to the documented HTTP contract, so clients cannot verify applied bounds; include `date_filter` in the YAML metadata output.

## Specific strengths
- **note-03446de3a213788ad52b** MCP expectations reflect fail-closed scope validation: Changed MCP enforcement assertions expect invalid-input errors for science date filters when the selected scope is not the audited OpenAlex-only scope. The tool-level expectations match the service's fail-closed policy rather than implying partial enforcement for a mixed or unsupported scope. Evidence: [ev-3ba1cb10bfe9d85bfde3b3ec](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/943f0b7ef670b3ffe4a3abb03b2aee54570e6a0c/AGENTS.md#L1), [ev-44ee5089d678c6b7a9c9e992](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/e62dfb16b09a0ae48de7d6aad2dfb065a9f7a441/tests/test_mcp_enforcement.py#L1), [ev-6dd79554a25bc786edc75b4b](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/e62dfb16b09a0ae48de7d6aad2dfb065a9f7a441/tests/test_mcp_enforcement.py#L276).
- **note-120d37463e3b73457f80** Broad HTTP date-filter test scenarios: The supplied test additions cover GET and POST paths, valid single and paired bounds, invalid and repeated bounds, upstream failure, OpenAPI discoverability, real-adapter filtering, and portal form/link preservation. These scenarios exercise several public-facing behaviors and failure cases for the date-filter contract. Evidence: [ev-83e57a7e53f0a31800a9cc9e](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/e62dfb16b09a0ae48de7d6aad2dfb065a9f7a441/tests/test_server.py#L766), [ev-fc5248947e528ba1a88019f3](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/e62dfb16b09a0ae48de7d6aad2dfb065a9f7a441/tests/test_server.py#L1).
- **note-2d533099cad7df90469b** Portal-facing date-filter contracts receive test coverage: The added server tests cover forwarding and enforcement metadata, invalid bounds before dispatch, upstream failure, OpenAPI date parameters, and preserving bounds in portal forms and links. These checks address the project rule that filter and HTTP behavior changes need portal-impact review and applicable deterministic contract coverage. Evidence: [ev-3ba1cb10bfe9d85bfde3b3ec](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/943f0b7ef670b3ffe4a3abb03b2aee54570e6a0c/AGENTS.md#L1), [ev-5de03785ce39c112ed51b7fd](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/943f0b7ef670b3ffe4a3abb03b2aee54570e6a0c/CONTRIBUTING.md#L1), [ev-fc5248947e528ba1a88019f3](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/e62dfb16b09a0ae48de7d6aad2dfb065a9f7a441/tests/test_server.py#L1).
- **note-3839c63bbafd005bd414** Adds regression coverage for scope rejection and cache proof: Changed test source covers rejection of mixed engines, reuse of matching proof-bearing cache entries, and refetching after removing proof from cached payloads. These cases exercise key boundaries of the changed date-filter contract in the supplied test source. Evidence: [ev-12cbc3694f203a7ff22bc7bc](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/e62dfb16b09a0ae48de7d6aad2dfb065a9f7a441/tests/test_filter_semantics.py#L1).
- **note-3df27248db1f211242cd** Portal navigation retains date bounds: The formatter carries date\_from and date\_to into hidden form inputs, pagination URLs, and machine-view links. Users can navigate pages or switch representations without silently losing the active date constraints. Evidence: [ev-fe481848e857e60bf9aff2d4](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/e62dfb16b09a0ae48de7d6aad2dfb065a9f7a441/slopsearx/formatter.py#L482).
- **note-47bfa04554279d8fe08d** MCP requires an explicit audited scope for absolute dates: The science tool rejects absolute date bounds unless the caller explicitly selects OpenAlex. This avoids accepting constraints against scopes that cannot provide the declared date enforcement. Evidence: [ev-e5597742c902058885fc4bbc](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/e62dfb16b09a0ae48de7d6aad2dfb065a9f7a441/slopsearx/mcp/tools.py#L1175).
- **note-48ca0f235faa48dad0f0** Repeated and unrecognized date controls are rejected: The HTTP handler detects repeated date bounds and unrecognized date-like controls and returns an invalid-filter response. This avoids silently selecting one of conflicting bounds or ignoring unsupported date controls. Evidence: [ev-be94e8bd9cd4c428c7b87b10](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/e62dfb16b09a0ae48de7d6aad2dfb065a9f7a441/slopsearx/server.py#L785).
- **note-6d059965c2ba6185817f** Escapes portal-generated control values: The supplied portal formatter HTML-escapes names and values when rendering hidden inputs, and URL-encodes state when constructing pagination and format links. This reduces the risk that search-state values are interpreted as HTML markup or malformed URL parameters. Evidence: [ev-fe481848e857e60bf9aff2d4](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/e62dfb16b09a0ae48de7d6aad2dfb065a9f7a441/slopsearx/formatter.py#L482).
- **note-6d0612c36d39d186058d** Cache entries require date proof: For absolute-date requests, cached responses without a matching date-filter proof are rejected as cache hits; the proof is also serialized and restored with the response. This prevents legacy cache payloads from being treated as evidence that the requested filter was enforced. Evidence: [ev-3ba1cb10bfe9d85bfde3b3ec](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/943f0b7ef670b3ffe4a3abb03b2aee54570e6a0c/AGENTS.md#L1), [ev-514554456a0eb8581ba027bb](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/e62dfb16b09a0ae48de7d6aad2dfb065a9f7a441/slopsearx/service.py#L1215), [ev-863529a22aaacea5eef6668c](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/e62dfb16b09a0ae48de7d6aad2dfb065a9f7a441/slopsearx/service.py#L1).
- **note-73b3a180fec1ffc8dea0** Portal URL and form state use a consistent allow-list: The hidden-input, pagination-URL, and machine-view-URL builders each include the date bounds as part of their explicit search-state values; hidden inputs HTML-escape rendered values. This keeps date-filter state coherent across portal navigation and avoids rendering unescaped values in hidden controls. Evidence: [ev-fe481848e857e60bf9aff2d4](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/e62dfb16b09a0ae48de7d6aad2dfb065a9f7a441/slopsearx/formatter.py#L482).
- **note-77c1fcd70d26fa52b639** Explicit audited date scope: The service rejects absolute-date requests combined with relative ranges or non-OpenAlex scopes, checks the selected adapter's enforcement layer before dispatch, and includes an enforcement proof in the response. This keeps the internal enforcement claim aligned with the admitted scope and avoids presenting unsupported mixed-source behavior as guaranteed. Evidence: [ev-3ba1cb10bfe9d85bfde3b3ec](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/943f0b7ef670b3ffe4a3abb03b2aee54570e6a0c/AGENTS.md#L1), [ev-863529a22aaacea5eef6668c](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/e62dfb16b09a0ae48de7d6aad2dfb065a9f7a441/slopsearx/service.py#L1), [ev-8c793aff2e7e2f4429a86d42](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/e62dfb16b09a0ae48de7d6aad2dfb065a9f7a441/slopsearx/service.py#L740).
- **note-78de356bca8352be3b30** HTTP date controls are carried into the shared request: The endpoint detects repeated or unknown date controls and passes recognized bounds into SearchRequest. Validation at the HTTP boundary and shared-service handoff help preserve consistent filter semantics across routes. Evidence: [ev-b0c34596113e86615bc99e9d](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/e62dfb16b09a0ae48de7d6aad2dfb065a9f7a441/slopsearx/server.py#L933), [ev-be94e8bd9cd4c428c7b87b10](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/e62dfb16b09a0ae48de7d6aad2dfb065a9f7a441/slopsearx/server.py#L785).
- **note-7ef004a32ad666bf6d31** Tests cover date-proof cache behavior: The changed tests check cache reuse with matching proof, rejection of a cached entry missing date proof, separation of date bounds, and refusal to dispatch through an unaudited adapter. These cases exercise important regressions around whether absolute-date enforcement is preserved across cache hits and adapter selection. Evidence: [ev-12cbc3694f203a7ff22bc7bc](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/e62dfb16b09a0ae48de7d6aad2dfb065a9f7a441/tests/test_filter_semantics.py#L1).
- **note-83650f39ce7615b6f019** Regression coverage follows the stricter scope contract: Changed test assertions cover rejection of mixed-engine date scopes, rejection of combined absolute and relative bounds, and cache proof behavior. These cases exercise the key compatibility boundaries introduced by the stricter service contract. Evidence: [ev-12cbc3694f203a7ff22bc7bc](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/e62dfb16b09a0ae48de7d6aad2dfb065a9f7a441/tests/test_filter_semantics.py#L1), [ev-3ba1cb10bfe9d85bfde3b3ec](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/943f0b7ef670b3ffe4a3abb03b2aee54570e6a0c/AGENTS.md#L1).
- **note-97d51f4da95c0fbde2f6** Portal search state retains absolute date bounds: The formatter includes date\_from and date\_to in hidden form inputs, page URLs, and machine-view URLs. This helps ensure navigation and format changes retain the user's bounded search state. Evidence: [ev-e308e7932188bcc424ee209c](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/e62dfb16b09a0ae48de7d6aad2dfb065a9f7a441/slopsearx/formatter.py#L1), [ev-fe481848e857e60bf9aff2d4](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/e62dfb16b09a0ae48de7d6aad2dfb065a9f7a441/slopsearx/formatter.py#L482).
- **note-c07c32a085e97ac41972** Test expectation aligns with unsupported-scope rejection: The updated test expects an invalid-input error and identifies the engines field when a science date bound is requested with only arxiv active. This makes the unsupported-scope behavior explicit instead of treating an unsupported date parameter as a warning while implying enforcement. Evidence: [ev-3ba1cb10bfe9d85bfde3b3ec](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/943f0b7ef670b3ffe4a3abb03b2aee54570e6a0c/AGENTS.md#L1), [ev-965516795365f2a0d7b4c481](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/e62dfb16b09a0ae48de7d6aad2dfb065a9f7a441/tests/test_mcp_tools.py#L1).
- **note-c35b82a4e22a53519f74** Rejects unaudited or mixed date-filter scopes before dispatch: The service requires explicit OpenAlex-only selection for absolute dates, verifies the resolved scope, and checks that the adapter declares upstream enforcement. This avoids presenting results from sources that do not enforce the requested date bounds as though the bounds applied to the whole search. Evidence: [ev-3ba1cb10bfe9d85bfde3b3ec](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/943f0b7ef670b3ffe4a3abb03b2aee54570e6a0c/AGENTS.md#L1), [ev-8c793aff2e7e2f4429a86d42](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/e62dfb16b09a0ae48de7d6aad2dfb065a9f7a441/slopsearx/service.py#L740).
- **note-c4189fec6a91ce37b7ee** Date-filter cache entries require matching enforcement proof: For bounded-date requests, cache reads reject entries whose date\_filter does not match the proof derived from the current request and cached response scope. A stale or pre-contract cache payload cannot be treated as evidence that the requested publication-date bounds were enforced. Evidence: [ev-514554456a0eb8581ba027bb](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/e62dfb16b09a0ae48de7d6aad2dfb065a9f7a441/slopsearx/service.py#L1215).
- **note-d52774a951446b1d5779** Portal navigation preserves applied date bounds: The portal hidden-input, pagination URL, and format URL builders include applied date\_from and date\_to values. Users can retain date-filter state while paging results or opening machine-readable views. Evidence: [ev-fe481848e857e60bf9aff2d4](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/e62dfb16b09a0ae48de7d6aad2dfb065a9f7a441/slopsearx/formatter.py#L482).
- **note-d8d1ccb99ba45fc24111** Repeated date inputs are detected before search construction: The HTTP handler collects duplicate date parameters from query strings and form submissions and rejects unknown or repeated date controls before constructing the search request. The explicit validation makes ambiguous input handling visible at the request boundary rather than burying it in later search processing. Evidence: [ev-be94e8bd9cd4c428c7b87b10](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/e62dfb16b09a0ae48de7d6aad2dfb065a9f7a441/slopsearx/server.py#L785).
- **note-ea74378e247134dff65f** Requires cache evidence for absolute-date enforcement: Absolute-date cache reads compare the stored proof with the proof for the current request and treat entries without matching proof as misses. Legacy cache payloads cannot silently establish that a bounded search was enforced. Evidence: [ev-514554456a0eb8581ba027bb](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/e62dfb16b09a0ae48de7d6aad2dfb065a9f7a441/slopsearx/service.py#L1215).
- **note-ead8ee7e29c3300052d5** Absolute-date searches are restricted to an enforcing scope: The service rejects bounded-date requests combined with time\_range or non-OpenAlex engine/media settings, verifies the resolved scope and adapter enforcement layer, and rejects the request before continuing when those checks fail. This fail-closed gate avoids dispatching a request whose date constraint cannot be enforced by the selected source. Evidence: [ev-8c793aff2e7e2f4429a86d42](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/e62dfb16b09a0ae48de7d6aad2dfb065a9f7a441/slopsearx/service.py#L740).
- **note-f2d57e90a276c6a549a1** MCP responses expose filter enforcement metadata: The search envelope adds response.date\_filter to meta when present; the science tool also requires an explicit OpenAlex engine selection for absolute dates. Consumers can distinguish enforcement evidence from merely supplied date parameters and avoid ambiguous engine scopes. Evidence: [ev-d55fa7266a5dca889c7ae802](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/e62dfb16b09a0ae48de7d6aad2dfb065a9f7a441/slopsearx/mcp/tools.py#L1), [ev-e5597742c902058885fc4bbc](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/e62dfb16b09a0ae48de7d6aad2dfb065a9f7a441/slopsearx/mcp/tools.py#L1175).
